# WORLD Harvest

MetalVoice2 builds the Harvest pitch estimator and its common, FFT and MATLAB-style math routines from unmodified WORLD sources. The FFT includes routines by Takuya Ooura. The source revision is [c794856b537758a3d300757db2e5e31685a822c2](https://github.com/mmorise/World/tree/c794856b537758a3d300757db2e5e31685a822c2). See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).
